encode_relaxation: encode a neural network relaxation into a MIP solver from a JaxPR environment
solve_relaxation: solve a linear relaxation of a neural network using an LP or MIP solver
create_RelaxationSolver: create an abstract RelaxationSolver subclass to encode linear constraints for neural network verification
create_MIPSolver: create a MIPSolver subclass to encode mixed-integer activation constraints for ReLU networks
create_RelaxationTransform: create a RelaxationTransform to propagate relaxation constraints through a JAX computational graph
